description.description: The description provided for the key upon its creation

kind.description: The type of the key which determines how it can be used

role.description: The role of the key which determines its scope in CRUD operations that have role-based access control

created_at.description: When the key was created in ISO 8601 date-time format without timezone offset (UTC time)

updated_at.description: When the key was last updated in ISO 8601 date-time format without timezone offset (UTC time)

expires_at.description: When the key will expire in ISO 8601 date-time format without timezone offset (UTC time)

disabled_reason.description: The reason for the key's disablement if applicable

is_disabled.description: Whether or not the key is disabled from use

oneOf.description: The sending domain associated with the key required for 'domain' kind keys
